evidence: At the PR head, products/stamphog/AGENTS.md:84-85 defines the carve-out target as 'a non-internal, signal-report-carrying TaskRun matched through the tasks facade', and the new facade enforces exactly that: products/tasks/backend/facade/api.py:508 returns None when `task.internal` is set. But the only production self-driving implementation task is created by products/signals/backend/auto_start.py:244-266 with `internal=True` (and `ai_stage="implementation"`), a behaviour that landed on master 2026-07-06 (#68752), weeks before this PR was opened, and the PR does not touch auto_start.py, so the documented invariant is false for every real run and the webhook re-review leg at products/stamphog/backend/tasks/tasks.py:191-200 can never identify a real self-driving PR. The tests only pass because products/tasks/backend/tests/test_webhooks.py:1246-1256 and products/review_hog/backend/tests/test_inbox_trigger.py:66-79 hand-build tasks with `internal=False` instead of going through auto_start; the receiver leg carries the same stale comment at products/review_hog/backend/receivers.py:99-104 ('the auto-start implementation task is the only non-internal signal-report task'). The finding's description of the facade is inaccurate for this head (it checks `internal`, not `ai_stage`; ai_stage lives in run state via products/tasks/backend/models.py:618, not on Task), so the doc does not contradict the PR's own code, but the doc encodes the same wrong invariant as the code and the suggested fix (identify by signal report + `ai_stage == "implementation"`, drop the `internal` rule) is exactly what the merged variant of this feature adopted (commit abef3d7a59 rewrote the facade check to `(run.state or {}).get("ai_stage") != "implementation"` and deleted the receiver's `if task.internal` guard).
notes: I would downgrade to not_an_issue only if some production path created signal-report implementation runs with internal=False at this head; I found none (the Inbox 'Create PR' button also routes through auto_start._create_implementation_task_if_absent).
